en_title: As GTA 6 Skips Discs, GameStop CEO Says Digital-Only 'Has Hurt Consumers' and Retailers
cn_title: 随着《GTA6》跳过光盘，GameStop首席执行官称纯数字发行「损害了消费者」和零售商的利益
opus_summary: 《GTA6》发售时没有实体光盘，盒装版仅包含数字下载码。GameStop首席执行官Ryan Cohen称，转向纯数字游戏损害了消费者和GameStop，并剥夺了玩家转售或转借游戏的能力。Take-Two首席执行官Strauss Zelnick此前为不发行光盘的决定辩护，但近期没有排除推出光盘版的可能。

paragraphs.en: As GTA 6 launches without a physical disc, GameStop's CEO has warned that the industry's shift to digital-only games has hurt both consumers and retail.
paragraphs.cn: 随着《GTA6》发售时不提供实体光盘，GameStop首席执行官警告称，游戏行业转向纯数字版游戏的做法损害了消费者和零售业的利益。

paragraphs.en: In a well-timed shot across GTA 6's bow, GameStop boss Ryan Cohen blasted the decision to abandon physical discs as a bad move for players and his own business, as it removes a layer of ownership and the ability to re-sell games via the trade-in market — something that has historically fueled GameStop's revenue.
paragraphs.cn: GameStop老板Ryan Cohen适时向《GTA6》发出警告，抨击放弃实体光盘的决定对玩家和他自己的业务都不利，因为这剥夺了一层所有权，以及通过以旧换新市场转售游戏的能力——而这一市场历来推动着GameStop的营收。

paragraphs.en: "When you buy a game, you should be able to sell it, trade it or lend it to a friend," Cohen told Bloomberg . "Unquestionably, the decision to move to all digital has hurt consumers, and it's also hurt GameStop."
paragraphs.cn: Cohen告诉彭博社：「当你购买一款游戏时，你应该能够卖掉它、拿它去换购其他游戏，或者把它借给朋友。毫无疑问，转向全面数字化的决定损害了消费者的利益，也损害了GameStop的利益。」

paragraphs.en: "Of course they don't like [trade-ins] because removing a used copy eliminates an alternative to buying new," Cohen added, without referencing any specific publisher by name. "They're taking away competition."
paragraphs.cn: Cohen补充道：「他们当然不喜欢［以旧换新］，因为去掉一份二手游戏，就消除了一种购买新游戏之外的选择。他们正在消除竞争。」他没有点名提及任何具体发行商。

paragraphs.en: The decision to sell GTA 6 without a disc appears not to have dented the game's overall success. GTA 6 looks poised to shatter industry sales records — with analysts estimating preorders neared 20 million before the game went on sale — even though boxed copies include a digital download code inside only.
paragraphs.cn: 不带光盘销售《GTA6》的决定似乎没有影响这款游戏的整体成功。《GTA6》看起来有望打破游戏行业的销售纪录——分析师估计，在游戏开售前，其预订量已接近2000万份——尽管盒装版内只有一个数字下载码。

paragraphs.en: Cohen's sudden defense of physical discs is somewhat ironic, as it comes just four months after he publicly dismissed physical games as meaningless to GameStop's future. Appearing on a Bloomberg podcast back in July, Cohen was asked about reports that Sony planned to phase out physical PlayStation discs by 2028. Rather than sounding the alarm for retail, Cohen brushed off the threat entirely.
paragraphs.cn: Cohen突然为实体光盘辩护有些讽刺，因为就在四个月前，他还公开表示实体游戏对GameStop的未来毫无意义。Cohen在今年7月参加一档彭博社播客时，被问及有关索尼计划在2028年之前逐步淘汰PlayStation实体光盘的报道。Cohen没有为零售业敲响警钟，反而完全不把这一威胁当回事。

paragraphs.en: "It is totally, totally irrelevant," Cohen said of physical game sales at the time, arguing that GameStop had spent years pivoting away from traditional software toward higher-margin collectibles and trading cards. But with the biggest entertainment launch of the decade arriving without a resellable disc, Cohen appears far less indifferent to physical media's disappearance — and the foot traffic the second-hand market brings through GameStop's doors.
paragraphs.cn: Cohen当时谈到实体游戏销售时说：「这完全、完全无关紧要。」他认为，GameStop多年来一直在从传统软件转向利润率更高的收藏品和集换式卡牌。但随着这十年来规模最大的娱乐产品发售时不提供可转售的光盘，Cohen似乎不再对实体媒介的消失——以及二手市场为GameStop门店带来的客流——那么漠不关心。

paragraphs.en: Take-Two boss Strauss Zelnick has in the past defended the company’s decision not to release GTA 6 on a disc, insisting that when it comes to big games, discs “don’t really make sense for the consumer.” "In order to play video games, you need to be connected today,” Zelnick added. “So everyone's connected. So it's just a matter of the most efficient way to get the title into people's hands.” However, more recently, Zelnick has refused to rule out a disc version of GTA 6 ever coming out .
paragraphs.cn: Take-Two老板Strauss Zelnick过去曾为公司不发行《GTA6》光盘版的决定辩护，坚持认为对于大型游戏来说，光盘「对消费者来说并没有什么意义」。Zelnick补充道：「如今要玩电子游戏，你需要联网。所以每个人都连着网。因此问题只是在于以最高效的方式将游戏交到人们手中。」不过，最近Zelnick并未排除《GTA6》将来推出光盘版的可能性。

paragraphs.en: “So that's where the world is going in our opinion and I think Sony understands that," Zelnick said back in August . "We certainly understand that. It doesn't mean that we won't have physical additions now and then, I'm sure we will in the same way that there’s still vinyl in the recorded music business. But in other instances, it just won't make sense.”
paragraphs.cn: Zelnick在8月时说：「所以在我们看来，这就是世界发展的方向，我认为索尼明白这一点。我们当然也明白。这并不意味着我们不会时不时推出实体版本，我确信我们会这样做，就像唱片行业仍然有黑胶唱片一样。但在其他情况下，这就没有意义了。」
